title: Implied volatility per quote with Newton and bracket fallback
deliverables: per-quote table: expiry, strike, T, iv (decimal), status
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes [M] (expiry, strike, type, price), S, r, q, valuation date. DITANYAKAN: IV per quote [M] (decimal), NaN/flag where price violates bounds. RUMUS: card Conventions: T ACT/365; bounds call (max(S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}, 0), S e^{-qT}); Newton sigma -= (BS - P)/vega from sqrt(2 pi/T) P/S clipped; brentq fallback on [1e-4, 5]; toolkit implied_vol(price,S,K,T,r,kind,q), bs_price. JAWAB: 1) T per row. 2) bound check. 3) solve [M]. 4) reprice residual < 1e-8. 5) write.
pitfalls: T from the expiry label instead of dates

title: Forward per expiry from put-call parity
deliverables: per-expiry table: T, F, implied q, strike_used
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put mids per (expiry, strike) [M], r per expiry, S. DITANYAKAN: one forward per expiry [n_T]; implied q. RUMUS: card Conventions: choose K* minimising |C - P| per expiry; F = K* + e^{rT}(C - P); q_impl = r - ln(F/S)/T; optionally regress C - P = e^{-rT}(F - K) over near-ATM strikes. JAWAB: 1) pair calls/puts by strike. 2) K* per expiry. 3) F [n_T]. 4) q_impl. 5) check F increasing smoothly with T for constant carry. 6) write.

title: Surface from OTM quotes with parity conversion
deliverables: long table: expiry, strike, iv, source
frame: DIKETAHUI: chain [M] with calls and puts, S, r, q or per-expiry F. DITANYAKAN: IV surface [n_T x n_K] from OTM quotes. RUMUS: card Conventions: K < F use put, K >= F use call; equivalent call price C = P + S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}; IV via implied_vol; pivot expiry x strike. JAWAB: 1) F per expiry. 2) choose side per row. 3) IV [M]. 4) pivot [n_T x n_K] (NaN where missing). 5) check smile continuity across F. 6) write.
formulas: C = P + S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}

title: Deribit inverse BTC-quoted options to USD and implied vol
deliverables: per-quote table: T, F, price_usd, iv (decimal)
frame: DIKETAHUI: Deribit quotes [M] (instrument, expiry ms timestamp, strike, call/put, BTC premium, underlying/index price, mark IV in percent). DITANYAKAN: USD premium, T, forward, IV [M]. RUMUS: card Conventions: T = (expiry_ms - now_ms)/(1000 x 86400 x 365); USD = BTC premium x F (or underlying); forward from parity in BTC: F = K/(1 - (c - p)); IV from USD prices with r = 0 Black76 or given mark IV /100. JAWAB: 1) parse instrument names. 2) T. 3) F per expiry. 4) USD price. 5) IV. 6) write.
formulas: F = K/(1 - (c - p)) with c, p in BTC

title: Expiry year fractions from timestamps and day counts
frame: DIKETAHUI: valuation timestamp, expiries [n_T] as dates or ms timestamps, basis (default ACT/365). DITANYAKAN: T [n_T] (years). RUMUS: card Conventions: ACT/365 calendar: T = days/365; ms: T = dms/(1000 x 86400 x 365); trading-day basis: business days/252 only when stated; toolkit year_fraction(start, end, basis). JAWAB: 1) parse to UTC. 2) differences. 3) T. 4) drop T <= 0. 5) write.

title: Total implied variance grid and calendar arbitrage check
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV surface [n_T x n_K] (decimal), T [n_T], F [n_T]. DITANYAKAN: w = iv^2 T; calendar violations. RUMUS: card Core 4: k = ln(K/F_T); calendar no-arbitrage: w(k, T) non-decreasing in T at each FIXED k (interpolate each slice in k onto a common k grid). JAWAB: 1) w per slice. 2) common k grid. 3) interp w(k) per T. 4) diffs along T < -tol -> violation list (T_i, k). 5) write.
pitfalls: checking at fixed K instead of fixed forward moneyness

title: Butterfly arbitrage check on call prices
frame: DIKETAHUI: call prices per expiry on strike grid [n_K] (possibly non-uniform), S, r, q, T. DITANYAKAN: arbitrage violation counts. RUMUS: card Invariants: C non-increasing in K, convex: (C_{i+1} - C_i)/(K_{i+1} - K_i) >= (C_i - C_{i-1})/(K_i - K_{i-1}); bounds max(S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}, 0) <= C <= S e^{-qT}; slope >= -e^{-rT}. JAWAB: 1) sort strikes. 2) slopes [n_K - 1]. 3) monotone, slope bound, convexity checks. 4) list violations. 5) write.

title: Risk-neutral density from call prices (Breeden-Litzenberger)
deliverables: summary json: integral, mean vs forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: call prices on fine strike grid [n_K] for one T, r. DITANYAKAN: density q(K) [n_K], integral, mean. RUMUS: q(K) = e^{rT} d^2C/dK^2; discrete second difference (non-uniform: np.gradient twice, or 2[(C_{i+1} - C_i)/h_+ - (C_i - C_{i-1})/h_-]/(h_+ + h_-)); integral sum q dK ~ 1; mean ~ F. JAWAB: 1) sorted grid. 2) C_KK. 3) q. 4) trapezoid integral, first moment. 5) negative q -> butterfly arbitrage flag. 6) write.
formulas: int q dK = 1, int K q dK = F

title: Raw SVI fit per expiry slice on total variance
triggers: parameters a b rho m sigma
deliverables: per-slice table: T, a, b, rho, m, sigma, rmse_vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV quotes per expiry (strike, iv) [n_T slices], F [n_T]. DITANYAKAN: SVI params per slice [n_T], RMSE in vol units. RUMUS: card Core 3: k = ln(K/F); w = iv^2 T; w(k) = a + b[rho(k - m) + sqrt((k - m)^2 + s^2)]; minimise sum (w_model - w)^2 subject to b >= 0, |rho| < 1, s > 0, a + b s sqrt(1 - rho^2) >= 0; RMSE_vol = sqrt(mean((sqrt(w_model/T) - iv)^2)). JAWAB: 1) k, w per slice. 2) initial guess (a = min w, b ~ 0.1, rho = -0.5, m = 0, s = 0.1). 3) scipy least_squares with bounds. 4) RMSE. 5) write.
pitfalls: fitting in ln(K/S) instead of ln(K/F)
fitting IV directly when total variance is the target

title: SVI parameter constraint and Lee wing check
deliverables: per-slice table: constraint flags, min_w, wing_slopes
frame: DIKETAHUI: SVI params per slice [n_T]. DITANYAKAN: validity flags per slice. RUMUS: card Core 3: b >= 0; |rho| < 1; s > 0; min w = a + b s sqrt(1 - rho^2) >= 0; Lee: right wing slope b(1 + rho) <= 2, left b(1 - rho) <= 2 (combined b(1 + |rho|) <= 2). JAWAB: 1) evaluate each condition. 2) min w and location k* = m - rho s/sqrt(1 - rho^2). 3) flag failures. 4) write.
formulas: min w at k* = m - rho s/sqrt(1-rho^2)

title: SVI butterfly density function g(k)
frame: DIKETAHUI: SVI params per slice, k grid [n_k]. DITANYAKAN: g(k) [n_T x n_k], min per slice, flag. RUMUS: card Core 3-4: R = sqrt((k - m)^2 + s^2); w_k = b[rho + (k - m)/R]; w_kk = b s^2/R^3; g = (1 - k w_k/(2w))^2 - (w_k^2/4)(1/w + 1/4) + w_kk/2 >= 0. JAWAB: 1) wide k grid (e.g. +-1.5 or data range). 2) w, w_k, w_kk analytic. 3) g. 4) min, argmin. 5) flag g < 0. 6) write.

title: SVI calendar arbitrage between fitted slices
deliverables: summary json: pairs with crossings, max violation
frame: DIKETAHUI: SVI params for sorted expiries [n_T], k grid. DITANYAKAN: calendar violations between adjacent slices. RUMUS: card Core 4: w(k, T_{i+1}) - w(k, T_i) >= 0 for all k on the grid; forward variance (w_{i+1} - w_i)/(T_{i+1} - T_i) > 0. JAWAB: 1) evaluate w per slice on common k. 2) differences. 3) list (i, k, diff) negatives. 4) ATM forward variance per interval. 5) write.

title: Natural SVI parametrisation and conversion to raw
deliverables: per-slice table: raw params, natural params, max reconstruction error
frame: DIKETAHUI: natural SVI (D, om, mu, rho, z) or raw params. DITANYAKAN: conversion and check. RUMUS: card Core 3: natural w = D + (om/2)[1 + z rho(k - mu) + sqrt((z(k - mu) + rho)^2 + 1 - rho^2)]; raw from natural: a = D + (om/2)(1 - rho^2), b = om z/2, m = mu - rho/z, s = sqrt(1 - rho^2)/z, rho same. JAWAB: 1) convert. 2) evaluate both on k grid. 3) max abs diff ~1e-12. 4) write.
formulas: a = D + om(1 - rho^2)/2, b = om z/2, m = mu - rho/z, s = sqrt(1-rho^2)/z

title: SVI jump-wing (JW) parameters from raw SVI
deliverables: per-slice table: v_t, psi_t, p_t, c_t, vtilde_t
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw SVI per slice and T. DITANYAKAN: JW params. RUMUS: w_t = a + b[-rho m + sqrt(m^2 + s^2)]; v_t = w_t/T; psi_t = (b/(2 sqrt w_t))(-m/sqrt(m^2 + s^2) + rho); p_t = b(1 - rho)/sqrt w_t; c_t = b(1 + rho)/sqrt w_t; vtilde_t = (a + b s sqrt(1 - rho^2))/T. JAWAB: 1) per slice compute. 2) checks: p_t, c_t >= 0, vtilde <= v. 3) write.

title: ATM implied skew and curvature from a smile slice
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV per strike per expiry or SVI params, F per expiry. DITANYAKAN: ATM vol, skew dsigma/dk at k = 0, curvature [n_T]. RUMUS: sigma(k) = sqrt(w(k)/T); dsigma/dk = w_k/(2 sqrt(w T)); d2sigma/dk2 from w_kk; or central differences on interpolated sigma(k). JAWAB: 1) k grid around 0. 2) derivatives. 3) per expiry. 4) skew term structure ~ T^{-1/2} check optional. 5) write.

title: Variance swap strike from an SVI slice
frame: DIKETAHUI: SVI params per slice, F, r, T. DITANYAKAN: fair variance K_var per expiry. RUMUS: OTM price Q(K) from BS with sigma(k) = sqrt(w(k)/T); K_var = (2 e^{rT}/T) int Q(K)/K^2 dK over wide grid; check flat smile -> sigma^2. JAWAB: 1) dense K grid in k (e.g. +-5 sd). 2) Q via bs_price/black76_price. 3) trapezoid integral. 4) K_var, sqrt. 5) compare ATM variance (skew raises K_var). 6) write.

title: Dupire local volatility from call price grid with rates and dividends
deliverables: summary json: nan count, floor hits
frame: DIKETAHUI: call prices C [n_T x n_K] on grids T [n_T], K [n_K], r, q. DITANYAKAN: local vol [n_T x n_K]. RUMUS: card Core 1: sigma_loc^2 = [C_T + (r - q) K C_K + q C]/(0.5 K^2 C_KK); C_T at FIXED K (np.gradient axis 0 on T grid), C_K, C_KK along axis 1 (non-uniform spacing); floor/NaN when C_KK tiny. JAWAB: 1) gradients. 2) numerator, denominator. 3) local variance; floor (e.g. 1e-10) or NaN if denominator < tiny. 4) sqrt. 5) check positive interior. 6) write.
formulas: sigma_loc^2 = [C_T + (r-q) K C_K + q C]/(0.5 K^2 C_KK)
pitfalls: C_T at fixed k instead of fixed K

title: Dupire with zero rates or forward-measure prices
frame: DIKETAHUI: undiscounted (forward) call prices on (T, K) grid or r = q = 0. DITANYAKAN: local vol surface. RUMUS: card Core 1: sigma_loc^2 = 2 C_T/(K^2 C_KK); with forward prices C = e^{rT} C_spot and strikes in forward terms, the drift terms vanish. JAWAB: 1) confirm prices are forward/undiscounted. 2) C_T, C_KK. 3) ratio, floor. 4) write.

title: Gatheral local vol from SVI slices with analytic k-derivatives
frame: DIKETAHUI: SVI params per slice [n_T], T [n_T], F [n_T], target (T, k) grid. DITANYAKAN: local vol [n_T x n_k]. RUMUS: card Core 2-3: sigma_loc^2 = w_T/[1 - (k/w) w_k + 0.25(-0.25 - 1/w + k^2/w^2) w_k^2 + 0.5 w_kk]; w_k, w_kk analytic SVI; w_T at FIXED k by finite difference across slices (or linear interpolation of w in T). JAWAB: 1) w, w_k, w_kk on grid. 2) w_T at fixed k. 3) denominator check > 0 (equals g(k)). 4) local variance, sqrt. 5) write.

title: Local vol from a discrete implied vol grid by finite differences
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV grid [n_T x n_K] on K, T grids, S, r, q. DITANYAKAN: local vol [n_T x n_K]. RUMUS: card Core 2: F_T, k = ln(K/F_T) [n_T x n_K]; w = iv^2 T; re-grid onto common k by interpolation (or use exact spec); w_k, w_kk by np.gradient along k (edge_order as stated); w_T at fixed k along T; Gatheral formula; spec-named stencil/interpolator (e.g. PCHIP) used exactly. JAWAB: 1) k, w. 2) derivatives. 3) local variance with floor. 4) sqrt. 5) write.

title: Flat-volatility diagnostic for a Dupire implementation
deliverables: summary json: max_abs_error, mean_error, grid used
frame: DIKETAHUI: constant sigma, S, r, q, near-ATM grid (K/S 0.9-1.1), T grid, bump sizes. DITANYAKAN: max |sigma_loc - sigma|. RUMUS: card Completing: build BS call prices with bs_price at constant sigma; apply Dupire (Core 1) with small relative bumps or analytic grid; error ~ 1e-6. JAWAB: 1) grid. 2) prices. 3) local vol. 4) error stats away from wings (C_KK ~ 0). 5) write.

title: Local variance floor, cap and NaN handling
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw local variance surface (possibly negative or inf), floor eps (default 1e-10 or given), cap sigma_max, tiny threshold. DITANYAKAN: cleaned local vol and counts. RUMUS: card Completing: sigma^2 = max(raw, floor); NaN where |denominator| < tiny; sigma = min(sqrt, cap); optionally fill NaN by nearest/linear in K. JAWAB: 1) masks. 2) apply in stated order. 3) counts. 4) write.

title: Short-maturity local skew vs implied skew rule
frame: DIKETAHUI: local vol and implied vol near ATM for a short expiry (or SVI slice). DITANYAKAN: ATM skews and ratio. RUMUS: card Invariants: local skew dsigma_loc/dk ~ 2 x dsigma_imp/dk at short T; ATM local vol ~ ATM implied. JAWAB: 1) derivatives at k = 0 on both surfaces. 2) ratio. 3) flag if far from 2. 4) write.

title: Forward variance and forward volatility between expiries
deliverables: per-interval table: T1, T2, fwd_var, fwd_vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: ATM IV (or w) per expiry [n_T]. DITANYAKAN: forward variance per interval [n_T - 1]. RUMUS: card Core 4: fwd_var = (w(T2) - w(T1))/(T2 - T1) = (sigma2^2 T2 - sigma1^2 T1)/(T2 - T1); fwd_vol = sqrt(fwd_var); must be > 0. JAWAB: 1) sort expiries. 2) w. 3) differences. 4) flag non-positive (calendar arbitrage). 5) write.

title: Local vol interpolation between expiries and in strike
deliverables: function / table: sigma_loc(t, S) evaluated on requested points
frame: DIKETAHUI: local vol grid [n_T x n_K], query points (t, S) [Q]. DITANYAKAN: interpolated local vol [Q]. RUMUS: card Conventions: linear in T between expiries, flat outside grid; linear in K, flat beyond wings (or in log-moneyness if stated); piecewise-constant next/previous expiry only if specified (biases prices). Implement with np.interp twice or scipy RegularGridInterpolator + clipping. JAWAB: 1) clip queries to grid. 2) interpolate in K per bracketing expiry. 3) interpolate in T. 4) write.

title: Local vol Monte Carlo vanilla repricing
deliverables: per-contract table: mc_price, standard_error, surface_price, rel_error
frame: DIKETAHUI: local vol function/grid, S, r, q, vanilla strikes/expiries [M], n_paths, n_steps per year, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC prices, SE [M], relative error vs market/BS price from the implied surface. RUMUS: card Core 10: X += (r - q - 0.5 s^2)dt + s sqrt dt Z, s = sigma_loc(t_i, S_i) at START of step (current S_i); payoff at each expiry from the same paths. JAWAB: 1) Z [n_paths x n_steps] once. 2) step loop with interpolated local vol. 3) record S at expiries. 4) prices, SE. 5) rel error within a few %. 6) write.
formulas: X_{i+1} = X_i + (r-q-s_i^2/2) dt + s_i sqrt(dt) Z_i
pitfalls: local vol lookup at S0 or previous day instead of current S_i

title: Local vol Monte Carlo down-and-out barrier with daily close monitoring
deliverables: summary json: barrier_price, se, vanilla_price, hit_prob, survival_prob
frame: DIKETAHUI: local vol surface, S, K, H < S, T (days), r, q, sub-steps per day, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: DO call price, SE, hit probability. RUMUS: card Conventions: log-Euler LV steps; barrier tested only at the last sub-step of each day (daily close); knocked if S <= H; payoff alive x max(S_T - K, 0); hit + survival = 1. JAWAB: 1) simulate. 2) daily close indices. 3) alive flags. 4) price, SE, vanilla from same paths. 5) checks 0 <= DO <= vanilla. 6) write.
pitfalls: monitoring every sub-step when spec says daily close

title: Local vol vs Black-Scholes barrier price comparison
deliverables: summary json: lv_price, bs_price_atm_vol, bs_price_strike_vol, difference
frame: DIKETAHUI: implied surface, local vol surface, barrier spec, MC settings. DITANYAKAN: barrier price under LV vs BS with ATM vol and with strike vol. RUMUS: LV MC (card Core 10); BS closed form barrier_price at sigma_ATM and sigma(K); continuous vs daily monitoring via BGK shift. JAWAB: 1) LV MC price, SE. 2) BS prices at two vols (with BGK if discrete). 3) differences. 4) interpret skew effect on DO calls (negative skew raises vol near barrier). 5) write.
formulas: BGK: H -> H exp(-0.5826 sigma sqrt(dt))

title: Call surface monotonicity in maturity at fixed forward moneyness
deliverables: summary json: violations count and list
frame: DIKETAHUI: call prices [n_T x n_K], F per expiry, discount factors. DITANYAKAN: calendar violations. RUMUS: card Invariants: normalised call c(k, T) = C/(D F) with K = F e^{k} must be non-decreasing in T at fixed k (equivalent to w non-decreasing); with q = 0, r = 0: C(K, T) non-decreasing in T at fixed K. JAWAB: 1) normalise. 2) interpolate to common k. 3) diffs along T. 4) list violations. 5) write.
formulas: c(k,T) = C/(DF_T F_T) non-decreasing in T

title: Heston characteristic function (little trap) and martingale checks
deliverables: summary json: phi(0), phi(-i), expected forward, abs errors
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, r, q, T, kappa, theta, xi, rho, v0, test u values. DITANYAKAN: phi(u); checks phi(0) = 1, phi(-i) = S0 e^{(r-q)T}. RUMUS: card Core 6: b = kappa - rho xi i u, d = sqrt(b^2 + xi^2(i u + u^2)), g = (b - d)/(b + d), e = exp(-dT); D = (b - d)/xi^2 (1 - e)/(1 - g e); C = (r - q) i u T + kappa theta/xi^2[(b - d)T - 2 ln((1 - g e)/(1 - g))]; phi = exp(i u ln S0 + C + D v0). JAWAB: 1) complex numpy. 2) evaluate. 3) checks. 4) write.
pitfalls: original Heston form branch cut at long T

title: Heston European call by P1/P2 Fourier inversion
deliverables: per-contract table: P1, P2, heston_call, heston_iv
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, S0, r, q, contracts (K, T) [M]. DITANYAKAN: call prices [M] (and implied vols). RUMUS: card Core 7: P2 = 1/2 + (1/pi) int_0^inf Re[e^{-iu ln K} phi(u)/(iu)] du; P1 same with phi(u - i)/phi(-i); C = S e^{-qT} P1 - K e^{-rT} P2; integrate from 1e-8 to U (100+) with quad or Gauss-Legendre; IV via implied_vol. JAWAB: 1) vectorise phi over u nodes. 2) P1, P2 per contract. 3) price. 4) bounds checks. 5) IV. 6) write.
formulas: C = S e^{-qT} P1 - K e^{-rT} P2
P2 = 1/2 + (1/pi) int Re[e^{-iu lnK} phi(u)/(iu)] du
pitfalls: truncating at u = 50 for short T

title: Heston put via the same P1, P2 and parity check
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, S0, r, q, (K, T) [M]. DITANYAKAN: put prices [M] and parity residuals. RUMUS: card Core 7: Put = K e^{-rT}(1 - P2) - S e^{-qT}(1 - P1); C - P = S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT} exactly when same P1, P2 are reused. JAWAB: 1) P1, P2 once per contract. 2) call, put. 3) residual ~1e-12. 4) write.

title: Gauss-Legendre quadrature for Heston integrals
deliverables: table by n_nodes: price, abs diff vs reference
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, contract, upper limit U, node counts [L]. DITANYAKAN: price convergence vs number of nodes. RUMUS: x, w = numpy.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(n); map [-1,1] -> [0, U]: u = U(x + 1)/2, weights w U/2; integrand ~1/u near 0 handled (nodes never at 0); reference by scipy.integrate.quad with high limit. JAWAB: 1) loop n. 2) prices. 3) differences. 4) choose n, U meeting tolerance. 5) write.

title: Heston prices by Carr-Madan FFT
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, S0, r, q, T, N (power of 2), eta grid spacing, damping alpha. DITANYAKAN: call prices on log-strike grid; compare direct integration. RUMUS: psi(v) = e^{-rT} phi(v - (alpha + 1)i)/(alpha^2 + alpha - v^2 + i(2 alpha + 1)v); lambda = 2 pi/(N eta); k_u = -b + lambda u, b = N lambda/2; C(k) = e^{-alpha k}/pi Re[FFT(e^{i v_j b} psi(v_j) eta w_j)]. JAWAB: 1) grids. 2) FFT. 3) interpolate to target strikes. 4) compare P1/P2 prices. 5) write.

title: Heston model implied volatility smile
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, S0, r, q, T, strike grid [n_K]. DITANYAKAN: model IV per strike [n_K]. RUMUS: card Core 7 for prices; implied_vol inversion; check ATM IV ~ sqrt(average expected variance) = sqrt(theta + (v0 - theta)(1 - e^{-kappa T})/(kappa T)). JAWAB: 1) prices [n_K]. 2) IVs. 3) ATM check. 4) write.

title: Heston calibration to option prices by least squares
deliverables: summary json: kappa, theta, xi, rho, v0, rmse_price, rmse_iv, feller_ok
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes [M] (K, T, price or IV), S0, r, q, initial guess, bounds. DITANYAKAN: params, fit errors. RUMUS: card Conventions: minimise sum (C_model - C_mkt)^2 (or weighted) over kappa, theta, xi, v0 > 0, |rho| < 1; Feller penalty only if asked; scipy least_squares with bounds; model via card Core 7. JAWAB: 1) convert IV quotes to prices. 2) objective vectorised. 3) optimise (multi-start optional). 4) errors in price and IV. 5) Feller check 2 kappa theta >= xi^2. 6) write.

title: Heston calibration on implied vols with vega weighting
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV quotes [M], S0, r, q. DITANYAKAN: Heston params minimising IV errors; RMSE in vol. RUMUS: residual_i = (C^H_i - C^mkt_i)/vega_i ~ IV error (cheap) or exact IV inversion of model prices; vega from bs_greeks at market IV. JAWAB: 1) market prices and vegas. 2) weighted residuals. 3) optimise with bounds. 4) final exact IV errors. 5) write.

title: Feller condition and variance process diagnostics
deliverables: summary json: feller_ratio, feller_ok, E[v_T], long_run_vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: kappa, theta, xi, v0, horizons [n]. DITANYAKAN: Feller check, expected variance path, long-run vol. RUMUS: card Core 5: Feller 2 kappa theta >= xi^2 (ratio 2 kappa theta/xi^2); E[v_t] = theta + (v0 - theta)e^{-kappa t}; Var[v_t] = v0 xi^2 e^{-kt}(1 - e^{-kt})/k + theta xi^2 (1 - e^{-kt})^2/(2k); long-run vol sqrt(theta). JAWAB: 1) ratio, flag. 2) E[v_t], Var[v_t] [n]. 3) write.

title: Heston Monte Carlo with full-truncation Euler
deliverables: summary json: mc_price, standard_error, cf_price, z
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, S0, K, T, r, q, n_steps, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE vs CF price. RUMUS: card Variants V4(a): v+ = max(v, 0); v_{n+1} = v + kappa(theta - v+)dt + xi sqrt(v+ dt) Z2; X_{n+1} = X + (r - q - v+/2)dt + sqrt(v+ dt) Z1; Z2 = rho Z1 + sqrt(1 - rho^2) Z_perp. JAWAB: 1) draws [n_paths x n_steps x 2]. 2) loop. 3) payoff, price, SE. 4) z vs Fourier price (bias shrinks with dt). 5) write.
formulas: X += (r - q - v+/2) dt + sqrt(v+ dt) Z1
pitfalls: using v not v+ inside sqrt

title: Heston Monte Carlo with Andersen QE scheme
frame: DIKETAHUI: Heston params, contract, n_steps, n_paths, seed, psi_c (default 1.5). DITANYAKAN: QE MC price, SE. RUMUS: m = theta + (v - theta)e^{-k dt}; s^2 = v xi^2 e^{-k dt}(1 - e^{-k dt})/k + theta xi^2(1 - e^{-k dt})^2/(2k); psi = s^2/m^2; psi <= psi_c: b^2 = 2/psi - 1 + sqrt(2/psi) sqrt(2/psi - 1), a = m/(1 + b^2), v' = a(b + Z)^2; else p = (psi - 1)/(psi + 1), beta = (1 - p)/m, v' = 0 if U <= p else ln((1 - p)/(1 - U))/beta; log-S step with K0..K4 weights. JAWAB: 1) loop. 2) price, SE. 3) compare CF. 4) write.

title: Variance swap fair strike under Heston
frame: DIKETAHUI: kappa, theta, v0, maturities [n_T]. DITANYAKAN: fair variance per T. JAWAB: 1) formula per T. 2) sqrt for vol strike. 3) MC check: average of simulated v. 4) write.

title: SABR Hagan implied Black vol per strike
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, T, alpha, beta, rho, nu, strikes [n_K], discount factor. DITANYAKAN: Black vol and price per strike. RUMUS: card Core 8: L = ln(F/K), z = (nu/alpha)(FK)^{(1-beta)/2} L, x(z) = ln[(sqrt(1 - 2 rho z + z^2) + z - rho)/(1 - rho)]; sigma_B = alpha/[(FK)^{(1-beta)/2}(1 + (1-beta)^2 L^2/24 + (1-beta)^4 L^4/1920)] (z/x) [1 + ((1-beta)^2 alpha^2/(24(FK)^{1-beta}) + rho beta nu alpha/(4(FK)^{(1-beta)/2}) + (2 - 3rho^2)nu^2/24)T]; z/x -> 1 at K = F; price black76_price. JAWAB: 1) vector over K. 2) ATM limit handled. 3) prices. 4) write.

RUMUS: minimise sum (sigma_SABR(K; alpha, beta, rho, nu) - sigma_mkt)^2 with alpha > 0, |rho| < 1, nu > 0; optionally alpha from ATM vol (cubic root) leaving rho, nu free. JAWAB: 1) initial guess (alpha ~ sigma_ATM F^{1-beta}, rho = 0, nu = 0.5). 2) least_squares. 3) RMSE. 4) write.

title: SABR alpha from ATM volatility (cubic)

RUMUS: ATM: sigma_ATM F^{1-beta} = alpha[1 + ((1-beta)^2 alpha^2/(24 F^{2-2beta}) + rho beta nu alpha/(4 F^{1-beta}) + (2 - 3rho^2)nu^2/24)T] -> cubic c3 alpha^3 + c2 alpha^2 + c1 alpha - sigma_ATM F^{1-beta} = 0; take smallest positive real root (np.roots). JAWAB: 1) coefficients. 2) roots. 3) pick root. 4) verify sigma_SABR(F) = sigma_ATM. 5) write.
formulas: c3 = (1-beta)^2 T/(24 F^{2-2beta}), c2 = rho beta nu T/(4 F^{1-beta}), c1 = 1 + (2-3rho^2) nu^2 T/24
